name: keel-modules
description: Verified readable sources for on-chain KEEL JavaScript modules.

scripts.test: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm vectors
scripts.typecheck: for config in modules/*/*/*/tsconfig.json template/tsconfig.json scripts/tsconfig.json; do echo "== tsc -p $config"; ./node_modules/.bin/tsc -p "$config" || exit 1; done
